title: Dobyns Rods Maverick Casting Gear Mv7.2 Red LH

comparisons.notes: Exact Maverick 7.2 Casting Red LH; size 100; 7.2:1; LH; Add to cart at $69.99 (was $99.99)

writeup: Woot has the Dobyns Maverick size 100 baitcasting reel in red with a 7.2:1 gear ratio and left-hand retrieve, new, for $29.99. Dobyns sells that exact Maverick 7.2 Casting Red LH on its own site for $69.99, so this is 57% less and about $40 under the manufacturer's current price. It is a 100-size reel with 11+1 bearings. Woot showed only 1 left, with a limit of three per customer.
